title: John Glenn urged Harry Reid to investigate UFOs

tellings.quote: Glenn who urged Harry Reid to investigate UFOs as part of Asa

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that John Glenn, the American astronaut who later became a senator, urged Harry Reid, a powerful US senator, to investigate UFOs. Michels links this to a Pentagon study of unexplained phenomena that Reid helped set up. If true, it would mean one of America's most famous astronauts quietly pushed for the government to take UFOs seriously.
